script:
# D3-SO-002: Tertiary solvolysis produces an acidic coproduct
# Simulation candidate; no runtime observations are claimed.
register lv3
new
add v1 water 50mL @ 25C
add v2 water 50mL @ 25C
add v1 tert_butyl_bromide 0.0002mol
react v1 haloalkane
measure v1 ph
measure v2 ph
measure v1 conductivity
measure v2 conductivity
chromatograph v1
particles v1
inspect
